meta.title: Scott County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Scott County's 2026 budget, adopted by Ordinance 2026-1 and filed with the state. Amounts come from the FY2026 column of each fund and office page in Exhibit A. Some money moves between county funds (for example $239,660.64 from the 911 Fund to the Jail fund), so those dollars appear in both funds.

nodes.name: County General Fund
nodes.note: No fund total is printed on the department pages; this is the sum of its departments.

nodes.name: Local Assistance and Tribal Consistency Fund
nodes.note: Section 19 of the ordinance has the treasurer move money from this fund, as the clerk requests, to pay salaries; those salaries may also appear in other offices' budgets. No 'Total Department Budget' is printed; this is the sum of its category totals.

nodes.name: Personal Pay Raises
nodes.note: Section 19 of the ordinance has the treasurer move money from this fund, as the clerk requests, to pay salaries; several funds' revenue pages show 'transfer for raises' coming in, so some of this money may be counted twice. No 'Total Department Budget' is printed; this is the sum of its category totals.

nodes.name: Supplies
nodes.note: Printed as 'Total Other Services and Charges', but it closes the Supplies section (line 1807-0421-2001 General Supplies).
